answer: A single Glaze earthenware carver clay licence does the work of a whole committee: a licence earthenware carvers carry after carving room audits, verified by a stranger. A farm running 504 aliases pays 504 times over: 58968 POA locked against one honest agent's single stake. The nectar names the issuer, the vine names the price, and the echo names the date: a forger must forge all three. One real credential beats a hundred printed ones, every epoch.
